import io, json, contextlib
from mixroom.cli import main
from mixroom.tracks.io import load_csv
b = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(b):
    main(['json', 'tracks', 'data/tracks.csv'])
got = json.loads(b.getvalue())
want = [x.to_dict() for x in load_csv('data/tracks.csv').all()]
print(got == want, len(b.getvalue().strip().splitlines()))
from mixroom.sessions.io import load_csv
b = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(b):
    main(['json', 'sessions', 'data/sessions.csv'])
got = json.loads(b.getvalue())
want = [x.to_dict() for x in load_csv('data/sessions.csv').all()]
print(got == want, len(b.getvalue().strip().splitlines()))
